name: Headshot Damage Redirection
teaser: Survive headshots by redirecting damage to other body parts. Fully configurable split ratios, thresholds, and RNG options. Stop getting one-tapped and fight back! Compatible with SPT 4.0.7 & FIKA
description_html:
Credit to Solarint for the original mod and Somtam for enhancements. I’ve updated it for SPT 4.0.7 and verified it works great!

What does it do?

Tired of getting instantly killed by headshots? This mod splits incoming head/chest damage between multiple body parts, giving you a chance to survive and fight back.

Default behavior (60% redirect):

  • Take a 100 damage headshot
  • Head takes: 40 damage
  • Other body parts: 60 damage (split)
  • You survive to tell the tale!

Key Features

Fully Configurable - Adjust redirect percentage, damage thresholds, body part targets Chest Protection - Optional chest damage redirection Smart Thresholds - Ignore low-damage hits, cap maximum damage RNG Mode - Add chance-based redirection for unpredictability In-Game Feedback - See exactly how damage was redirected Dad Gamer Mode - Global damage reduction slider for casual play

Configuration (F12 in-game)

All settings accessible via BepInEx Configuration Manager:

  • Redirect percentage (0-100%)
  • Minimum damage threshold
  • Maximum damage cap
  • Chance to activate
  • Body part selection
  • And more!

Issues?

Report them here https://github.com/perfk/Solarint-HeadshotDamageRedirect/issues and will do my best to help

Installation

  1. Download zip
  2. Extract in your SPT folder
  3. Launch game
  4. Press F12 to configure settings

Compatibility

  • SPT 4.0.7
  • FIKA Compatible - Tested with friends and seem to work fine
  • Tested with SAIN and appears to work fine

Credits

  • Original: Solarint
  • Updated by: Somtam
  • Updated for 4.0.7: Perfk

If either Solarint or Somtam updates their mod then will i of course take this down
